name: fireworks
summary: Successfully completed the Fireworks AI Serverless Quickstart end-to-end. Installed the OpenAI Python SDK, configured the client with the Fireworks base URL and the FIREWORKS_API_KEY environment variable, and made a chat.completions.create call. The API returned a chat completion: "¡Hola! (Hello!)".
deviations: The quickstart docs specify model "accounts/fireworks/models/deepseek-v3p1", which returned a 404 NOT_FOUND error. I listed available models via the API and substituted "accounts/fireworks/models/deepseek-v4-pro", which succeeded and returned the chat completion.
